I'm Ali Turab — a Computer Science student at COMSATS University Islamabad, Lahore Campus, currently in my 5th semester. With a CGPA of 3.38/4.0, I combine strong academics with real-world industry experience in both data and web domains.

My interests sit at the intersection of Data Science and Web Development. I'm experienced in Python-based data workflows — from cleaning and exploratory analysis to building automation scripts. On the web side, I build responsive, cross-browser compatible sites using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

I've interned as a Data Science Intern at Code Alpha, worked as a freelance Web Developer, and completed a seasonal MS Developer Internship — all while building projects that solve genuine, real-world problems.

Things I've Built

A selection of projects spanning data analysis, database design, and object-oriented programming — each solving a real problem.

2025 · Python, Scikit-learn, Streamlit
Customer Churn Prediction
An end-to-end machine learning pipeline built on the Telco Customer Churn dataset — covering data cleaning, exploratory analysis, and feature engineering in Google Colab. Trained and evaluated classification models including Logistic Regression, Decision Tree, and Random Forest to predict churn likelihood. Deployed as an interactive Streamlit app for real-time churn prediction from user-input customer data.
Python Scikit-learn Pandas Streamlit Google Colab

2025 · Python, OpenCV, MediaPipe, Streamlit
Sign Language Understanding System
A real-time sign language recognition system combining OpenCV for live video capture and MediaPipe for precise hand landmark detection. Processes hand landmark coordinates to classify and recognize sign gestures into corresponding letters and words, with detection accuracy improved through tuned landmark preprocessing and confidence thresholds. Delivered through an interactive Streamlit interface for live webcam-based gesture recognition.
Python OpenCV MediaPipe Computer Vision Streamlit

Cambridge School Website
A fully responsive multi-page website for a school, featuring Home, About Us, Contact Us, and Alumni pages. Built with a clean, mobile-friendly UI using Tailwind CSS and reusable navigation and footer components across pages. Includes a working contact form and an embedded Google Maps location for the school's physical address, with vanilla JavaScript powering interactive UI elements like a scroll-to-top button.

Hotel Management System
